description: Implementation of QuicSpdyServerStreamBase class methods for handling HTTP/QUIC streams, including header validation and stream control.

classes.name: QuicSpdyServerStreamBase
classes.description: A class representing a server-side HTTP/QUIC stream with header validation and stream control functionalities.

methods.name: QuicSpdyServerStreamBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with stream ID, session, and type.

methods.name: QuicSpdyServerStreamBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with a pending stream and session.

methods.name: CloseWriteSide
methods.description: Closes the write side of the stream, optionally sending a stop signal if conditions are met.

methods.name: StopReading
methods.description: Stops reading from the stream and signals the peer to stop sending data if appropriate.

methods.name: AreHeadersValid
methods.description: Validates HTTP headers for the stream, including checks for required pseudo headers and request validity.
